mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% for three consecutive months reduces the present value of expected corporate cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% and remains above for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no statistically significant negative relationship with the FEDFUNDS rate change (p > 0.05) in the identified regime.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 3% for two consecutive months, the market anticipates a pre-emptive rate hike by the Fed, which elevates risk-free rates and dampens equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In regimes where CPIAUCSL > 3% for > 2 months, the 20-day SPX forward return is positive or equal to the 5-day realized return (no predictive power).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly PAYEMS (employment growth) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in UNRATE (unemployment) signals a strengthening labor market, prompting investors to price in higher wage growth and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 2% month-over-month while UNRATE decreases by > 0.2 percentage points
failure_condition: In periods where PAYEMS > UNRATE thresholds are met, 5-day forward returns show no correlation with the labor indicators (Pearson's IC > 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDPC1 (real personal consumption) exceeding 3% for two consecutive months suggests robust demand momentum that outpaces supply, elevating equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows by > 3% month-over-month for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth exceeds threshold but 20-day SPX returns are negative or flat (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO (industrial production) falls by more than 5% in a month, it indicates supply-side weakness that reduces market capacity, causing investors to anticipate slower growth and sell off equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by > 5% in a single month
failure_condition: During INDPRO contractions, 60-day SPX forward returns are not significantly different from the 5-day realized return (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in RSAFS (money supply growth) below -2% for three consecutive months suggests deflationary pressures that the Fed may respond to with policy tightening, which compresses equity valuations and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below -2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: In deflationary RSAFS regimes, 20-day SPX forward returns are not statistically different from the 5-day realized return (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months while HOUST (housing starts) remains flat or increases, it indicates a labor market transition to tightness that prompts central bank rate hikes, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% for 2 consecutive months AND HOUST >= previous month
failure_condition: In labor-tightening regimes, 60-day SPX forward returns show no significant negative relationship with the UNRATE-HOUST interaction (IC > 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward sloping trend in the 5-day moving average of FEDFUNDS and a parallel downward sloping trend in the 5-day moving average of CPIAUCSL (inflation) over 10 consecutive weeks indicates a classic Fed 'higher for longer' scenario that is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: 5-day MA(FEDFUNDS) rising for 10 consecutive weeks AND 5-day MA(CPIAUCSL) falling for 10 consecutive weeks
failure_condition: The 20-day SPX forward return is not statistically different from the 5-day realized return when the interaction pattern persists (p > 0.05).
